name: bestlife-holder-ai
description: Asks your own AI on your own key, so your evidence goes only to the AI provider you chose.

AI_PROVIDER.description: anthropic, or openai-compatible for a model you run.

AI_MODEL.description: The model to ask (claude-opus-5-5 for Anthropic).

AI_ENDPOINT.description: For openai-compatible only: the base URL of your endpoint (https://…/v1).

AI_KEY_NAME.description: The name of your AI key on your access worker (a KEY_AI_API_KEY secret there).

BESTLIFE_CALLER_CN.description: The name Best Life signs its requests as: bestlife-caller. Leave it as it is. Empty: Best Life cannot call this worker.

ACCESS.description: Your access worker, which opens your AI key (deploy bestlife-holder-access first).
